author: ShinyShadowPulse
body:
I have been banned on avicus for saying "No Kys Please" I saw kiws in chat by  a player and thats why i said no kys please
I dont think i was encouraging the person i was actaully telling them dont type kys but i was in to playing so i wrote that for short and o apologize if it was included as a death encourgment but i didint know saying no kys please was a death encourgment SO i am really sorry
i wont be saying kys any more or anything with kys in chat. Sincerely, ShinyShadowPulse

title: Ban appeal

replies.author: FrostedCupcakez
replies.body:
Hello ShinyShadowPulse,

Thank you for appealing. Due to the sensitive nature of this subject, we tend to have a very strict policy when it comes to punishing for these scenarios. After reassessing the situation of the punishment, we have come to the conclusion that you will be appealed due to misinterpretation of your message.

However, please refrain from saying "kys" in the future due to the general consensus of how the message is interpreted by the majority. We appreciate you trying to help enforce our rules, however please be more wary of what you say in chat in the future.

Sincerely,
FrostedCupcakez | Jessica
